To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the addition of 6TIC as the non fullerene acceptors in the ternary SM OSC blends can effectively improve the performance of the ternary SM solar cells by enhancing the crystallinity of 6T IC in the blends and maintaining the face on orientation in a proper multi length scale morphological structure.
we developed an effective ternary strategy for SM OSCs based on a highly crystalline non fullerene acceptors (NFA) and achieved a certified efficiency of 15.5%.
we demonstrate all small molecule ternary organic solar cells with high power conversion efficiency by using a highly crystalline non-fullerene acceptor as the third component.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of highly efficient SM OSCs based on ternary strategy with a high crystalline acceptor.
the development of a new ternary SM OSC strategy based on a highly crystalline non fullerenes small molecule acceptor.
the development of a ternary blend system with a highly crystalline NFA and the demonstration of high performance SM OSCs based on such system.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the addition of the highly crystalline 4TIC to ZnP TSE H:6TIC ternary SM OSC leads to the highest efficiency of 15.5%.
the ternary strategy is an effective approach to further improve the efficiency of SM OSCs.

the addition of 2.5% 4TIC in 6TIC: TBO based SM OSCs and 1% 4Tic in 6Tic: TSEH based SM OSCs significantly enhances the crystalline of the blend film and improves the device performance by reducing the recombination and improving the extraction of charge carriers.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the ternary SM OSC is a promising approach to achieve high efficiency in SM OSCs, and the crystalline acceptor 4TIC with a similar molecular backbone as the host NFA 6TIC is a good choice to construct high performance ternary SM OSC devices.
the addition of 1% of 4T IC into the ZnP TSE H: 6T IC blend can significantly improve the PCE of SM OSCs from 13.53% to 15 88% (certi fied 15.5%) by increasing the J SC, FF, and V OC.
the ternary blend strategy is a promising way to further increase the PCE of SM OSCs.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the ternary strategy with a highly crystalline NFA can be an efficient method to further improve the performance of the SM OSCs.
the addition of 2TIC, 3TIC or 4TIC into 6TIC:ZnP TBO or ZnP TSE H based SM OSCs is a very effective way to improve the performance.

the addition of 5% 4TIC in the 6TIC: ZnP TSEB binary blend is able to significantly increase the crystallinity of 6TIC without sacrificing other important parameters, such as the open circuit voltage (Voc) and the short circuit current density (Jsc), to achieve the best PCE.
